/-- [nora_kernel::tokens::revoke_token]:
    Source: 'src/tokens.rs', lines 226:0-236:1
    Visibility: public -/
def tokens.revoke_token
  (store : tokens.TokenStore) (hash_prefix : Slice Std.U8) :
  Result (tokens.TokenStore × (core.result.Result Unit tokens.TokenError))
  := do
  let b ← tokens.is_valid_hash_prefix hash_prefix
  if b
  then
    let s := alloc.vec.Vec.deref store.files
    let b1 ← tokens.has_file s hash_prefix
    if b1
    then
      let s1 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref store.files
      let files ← tokens.remove_file s1 hash_prefix
      let s2 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref store.cache
      let cache ← tokens.invalidate_cache s2 hash_prefix
      ok ({ store with files, cache }, core.result.Result.Ok ())
    else
      let ts ← tokens.TokenStore.Insts.CoreCloneClone.clone store
      ok (ts, core.result.Result.Err tokens.TokenError.NotFound)
  else
    let ts ← tokens.TokenStore.Insts.CoreCloneClone.clone store
    ok (ts, core.result.Result.Err tokens.TokenError.NotFound)
